issues.on_page: Opioid Recovery - Local 50,000 (p9); combining schedule p13 shows this 50,000 'Local' in the Local Assist & Tribal Consistency column (Opioid Recovery there = 7,800 federal only)
issues.issue: The report's own schedules disagree about which fund holds this 50,000. It is recorded as printed on p9 with a review note, but the conflict is not in report_discrepancies. Local Assistance and Tribal Consistency money is normally federal, so 'other' may be the wrong category. A person should settle the fund and category.

Within this report the label 'Local' gets two categories: charges for services here (it equals p2 public works charges for services 62,243), but other on the statement line (receipts[4]) and on the General, 911, Debt Service, Transit and Inheritance 'Local' lines. config/category_decisions.csv decides 'local' as other (apply=label), so user_rules.py will probably overwrite this.
p2 public welfare charges for services are 180,437 (= Transit Local 180,427 + Transit taxes 10), which points to transit fares. The user's label decision ('local' -> other) keeps it in other.

This follows the user's label decision for 'Local'. The extractor rules say to look at contents, and p2 shows charges for services 1,216,583 (86%) plus interest income 194,996 (3,931 not explained). The fund type has about 10% in other.
